title: Law to require disclosure of paid political ads on social media
summary: This bill would require campaigns and independent spenders to include "paid for by" disclosures directly in political content posted on websites, apps and social media platforms, not just in accompanying text. It also directs the Campaign Finance Board to issue guidance on how existing disclosure, recordkeeping and reporting rules apply to such online content, including posts made by paid third parties. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
